metadata.title: Contact topology and intrinsic characterization of transversely vanishing curl eigenforms
metadata.abstract: We study the geometry and topology of transversely vanishing eigenforms of the curl operator on $3$-manifolds, placing them in the broader framework of near-contact forms. We prove a Gray-type stability theorem for the kernels of near-contact forms, which we call near-contact structures, and derive a local neighborhood theorem around their singularities. As applications, we obtain a stability result for the contact topology of curl eigenforms, a classification of near-contact structures in terms of formal homotopical data, and a proof of the existence of contact structures on closed orientable 3-manifolds based on the spectral theory of the curl operator. We also study the symplectization of curl eigenforms as a possible bridge to symplectic dynamics. Finally, we characterize those transversely vanishing $1$-forms which are curl eigenforms for some smooth Riemannian metric. We deduce a generalization of the classical correspondence, due to Etnyre and Ghrist, between Reeb-like fields of contact forms and nowhere-vanishing rotational Beltrami fields to the setting of transversely vanishing vector fields.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 奇异接触结构与谱刻画
analysis.workSummary: 研究三维流形上横截消失的 curl 特征一形式，以 near-contact 形式为框架，为其核分布建立 Gray 型稳定性及奇点邻域定理。由此得到 curl 特征形式的接触拓扑稳定性、按形式同伦资料的 near-contact 分类，并从 curl 谱理论给出闭可定向三维流形存在接触结构的另一证明。
techniques: near-contact 结构与奇点邻域模型
特征形式的内禀度量可实现性
analysis.breakthrough: 刻画哪些横截消失一形式可对某光滑黎曼度量成为 curl 特征形式，并把 Reeb-like 场与旋转 Beltrami 场的经典对应推广到允许横截零点的设置。
analysis.limitations: 横截消失是控制奇点的核心条件，不能推广到任意退化一形式。辛化与辛动力学的关系在摘要中仍定位为可能的桥梁，不是已证明的全面动力学等价。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露Claude Opus 5.5、ChatGPT 5.6主要用于后期校对及发现小错，并逐项说明数学贡献：给作者原有引理6.5证明提供等价的无坐标表述及另一段的替代论证；建议用命题4.5无穷小接触体积增长恢复低正则不变量，将微分同胚要求从C²降至C¹；指出定理3.1已有计算蕴含连续延拓，并提供奇点局部模型中接触向量场Y的显式形式。该具体降正则路线支持ideas，替代证明支持proofs；不能扩大为全部主要结果由AI提出。作者明确正文由本人撰写并对内容负责。
